source.author: verg
source.text: Ego te, quae plurima fando enumerare vales, numquam, regina, negabo promeritam; nec me meminisse pigebit Elissae, dum memor ipse mei, dum spiritus hos regit artus.
source.text_original: 'Ego te, quae plurima fando / enumerare vales, numquam, regina, negabo / promeritam; nec me meminisse pigebit Elissae, / dum memor ipse mei, dum spiritus hos regit artus.
source.text_english: I shall never deny, queen, that you have well earned my gratitude, you who can recount so many things in speaking; nor shall I ever be ashamed to remember Elissa, so long as I myself remember myself, so long as breath rules these limbs.

reuse.author: hier
reuse.text: Quia ergo insanivit Israel, et percussus fornicationis spiritu, incredibili furore bacchatus est, ideo non multo post tempore, sed dum propheto, dum spiritus hos regit artus, pascet eos Dominus quasi agnum in latitudine.
reuse.text_original: Quia ergo insanivit Israel, et percussus fornicationis spiritu, incredibili furore bacchatus est, ideo non multo post tempore, sed dum propheto, dum spiritus hos regit artus, pascet eos Dominus quasi agnum in latitudine.
reuse.text_english: Therefore, because Israel went mad and, struck by the spirit of fornication, raged in unbelievable frenzy, not long afterward, but while the prophet speaks, while the spirit governs these limbs, the Lord will feed them like a lamb in the open plain.
